parole.testo: From Middle English flemmysshe, from Old English flēmisc, from Old Frisian flāmisk, derived from Proto-Germanic *flaumaz (“flowing, current water”) and *-iskaz. Equivalent to English fleam + -ish. More at Flanders.

parole.motivo_incerta: Uncertain; perhaps; or possibly; modello unc/uncertain
